data.description:
# Align Herdr STAGES/STAGE_MAP/StageFilter with the CLI vocabulary

## Goal

As a Herdr user, I want the stage filter to cycle only through stages the `wl`
CLI recognises (`idea`, `intake_complete`, `plan_complete`, `in_review`, `done`),
so I never land on a filter that can only ever be empty.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` `STAGES` equals exactly the CLI stage vocabulary `['idea','intake_complete','plan_complete','in_review','done']`; `in_progress` and `completed` are removed.
- [ ] `Stage` (and any derived types) continue to typecheck, and no Herdr code hard-codes the removed `in_progress`/`completed` values as valid stages.
- [ ] `STAGE_MAP` accepts only CLI-valid canonical names and supported shorthand aliases; the `progress → in_progress` alias is removed while `intake`/`plan`/`review`/`done` aliases still resolve, and any `completed` mapping is removed.
- [ ] `StageFilter` cycles only the five valid stages (then clears to `null`).
- [ ] `/wl progress` and `/wl completed` fail soft (no crash, no invalid filter applied), consistent with the existing `/wl <bogus>` behaviour.
- [ ] Tests are added/updated for the exact `STAGES` list, `StageFilter` cycling/wrapping and `STAGE_MAP` alias resolution plus invalid-alias fail-soft.

## Minimal Implementation

- Trim `STAGES` to the five CLI stages; update the `Stage` union and any consumers.
- Trim `STAGE_MAP`: delete the `progress`/`in_progress` entries and any `completed` mapping.
- Update the `/wl <stage>` help/option lists to the aligned vocabulary.
- Add/adjust unit tests in `tests/herdr/worklist.test.ts`.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts`
- `tests/herdr/worklist.test.ts`

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: none.

## Deliverables

- Aligned `STAGES`, `Stage` type, `STAGE_MAP` and `StageFilter`.
